description: Use when you SELL or hold a token and want to find buyers: lists open requests for quotes on Bull (token, size in USD, window, buyer's price limit). Returns rfqIds to answer with bull_send_quote. Public, no signature needed. Not for finding market prices.

chain.description: Filter by chain slug as listed in /api/v1/trust, e.g. robinhood (optional, default: all chains).

token.description: Token contract address or mint to filter by (optional).

name: bull_list_rfqs
